scenarios.questionText: [Cognitive Bias Test 1] You are long on EUR/USD. While scrolling market commentary, you only click articles titled 'EUR/USD Bull Run Imminent' and ignore bearish reports. Which bias is active?
options: Confirmation Bias

Anchoring Bias
Gambler's Fallacy

Outcome Bias
